notes: Remediates live VS-16 discovery defects found through the isolated Expo Go test harness.
Business location becomes the owner-facing input; canonical country, timezone and currency are derived.
Multiple branch candidates require explicit owner selection; one strong candidate may be preselected but remains changeable.

Google Places Text Search (New) is the approved first test/pilot location adapter behind a replaceable provider boundary; timezone is read from the documented places.timeZone.id response and currency is Atlas-derived.

Google place types may provide a conservative public cuisine/type summary such as Turkish · Kebab or Indian · Pakistani; marketplace ordering boilerplate is cleared rather than retained as a business description.
The separate Google Time Zone API is not used by VS-21.
No production release or production enablement is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner approved automatic country/timezone/currency resolution, Google Maps/Places search for unknown locations, branch selection for multi-location businesses, and instructed implementation to proceed.

Product Owner approved the recommended lower-dependency approach: use Places Text Search (New) to return timezone in the same request and derive currency inside Atlas, with no separate Time Zone API call.
Live Expo testing exposed the Google Places timezone response-shape defect; remediation continued under the already approved VS-21 location-resolution scope.

Exact implementation SHA passed CI, Security baseline and Product Intake, including the documented timeZone.id response regression, Google place-type summary, marketplace boilerplate cleanup, API build/tests, and mobile preflight/runtime verification.

evidence: BusinessLocationResolutionTests: parses documented places.timeZone.id, derives MT/Europe-Malta/EUR, requests places.types, and keeps one Google provider request
Mobile business-location-resolution tests: cuisine/type summary replaces marketplace ordering boilerplate without overwriting a useful description
